annotations.title: Taxpayers by age band by postcode

description:
How many people lodging a tax return in each postcode are in each of six age bands, per income year 2016-17 to 2023-24.

Coverage: About 2,530 postcodes; income years 2016-17 to 2023-24. Current to 2024-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/taxpayer-age`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: age_under_25, age_25_34, age_35_44, age_45_54, age_55_64, age_65_plus. Omit for all.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
